in_sanskrit.name: Jesya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jesya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jesya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jesana', which means 'Goddess of Wealth'. This name holds significant importance in Hindu culture, as it is believed that the deity of wealth, Lakshmi, is invoked through the name. The name is often given to baby girls to ensure prosperity, wealth, and good fortune in their lives.
